name: Buddhaghosa
role: Indian Theravadin Buddhist commentator, translator, and philosopher
contribution: A 5th-century Indian Theravādin Buddhist commentator, translator, and philosopher.
legacy: His best-known work is the Visuddhimagga, a comprehensive summary of older Sinhala commentaries on the scriptural canon of the Theravāda school.

checks.lead: Buddhaghosa was a 5th-century Indian Theravādin Buddhist commentator, translator, and philosopher. He worked in the great monastery (mahāvihāra) at Anurādhapura, Sri Lanka and saw himself as being part of the Vibhajyavāda school and in the lineage of the Sinhalese mahāvihāra.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
